document: P09 rule and project decision matrix
status: decision-support draft; no new user decisions recorded
evidence_policy: Separate official published text from unknown original-game rules, project direction, provisional parameters, and actual implementation evidence. No gameplay was run or measured for this document.

sources.access_and_limit: As recorded in T01 rules_matrix.md: full text fetched on 2026-10-10 UTC (2026-10-11 Asia/Shanghai). FAQ says KatamariBall is playable with friends, up to four per room, and lists Magnet/timer/rocket with platform activation controls. It does not establish detailed PVP interactions.

As recorded in T01 rules_matrix.md: full text fetched on 2026-10-10 UTC (2026-10-11 Asia/Shanghai). Announcement describes KatamariBall as a four-player battle mode: grow the ball within a time limit, exchange it for points, highest score wins. It does not specify transaction, KO, respawn, or item-in-PVP rules.

sources.limit: Project direction/prototypes, not evidence of original-game rules or implementation.

official_confirmed: KatamariBall is described as a four-player battle mode.
Players grow a Katamari within a time limit and exchange it for points; highest score wins.
unknown: Exact match duration, number of rounds/sets, tie handling, and whether the four-player mode uses any CPU fill in every online context.
project_decision_or_prototype: PCVR + Desktop first release; Quest excluded.
Project scope suggests 2–4 human players and has a provisional 180-second single-round prototype; neither is an original-game measurement.

candidates.description: Start with the project provisional duration and expose it as test configuration.
candidates.reject_basis_if_not_selected: A fixed value is not justified as an original-game fact; playtest may show it is too short/long.

candidates.description: Decide after observing pacing and scoring in the project.
candidates.reject_basis_if_not_selected: Requires more evidence and delays locking the loop; still does not reveal original duration.

candidates.description: Only if a later explicit product decision supports it.
candidates.reject_basis_if_not_selected: Adds reset, progression, and fairness complexity not required by current scope.

decisions.decision_owner: user_and_lead; implementation parameters after relevant playtest
decisions.do_not_claim: Do not state that 180 seconds or project 2–4 participation reproduces the original rules.

official_confirmed: The publisher says the Katamari is exchanged for points within the time limit and the highest score wins.
unknown: Exchange location, manual/automatic trigger, range, interruption, frequency, score formula, whether all growth is exchanged, ball reset, and deadline ordering.
project_decision_or_prototype: Project uses unbanked risk growth and confirmed banked score as distinct ledgers; score ranking uses confirmed banked points.

candidates.option: Project explicit banking zone and transaction
candidates.description: Use the current project contract: request/confirmation, idempotency, reset only on confirmed transaction.
candidates.reject_basis_if_not_selected: It is a chosen project design direction, not proof of original exchange implementation.

candidates.option: Alternative exchange flow after project tests
candidates.description: Compare automatic, manual, or multiple exchange points only through a scoped project decision.
candidates.reject_basis_if_not_selected: Would change map, UI, transaction, and fairness requirements.

decisions.do_not_claim: Do not claim the original uses a fixed/moving bank, particular ratio, reset, or interruption behavior.

unknown: Whether KatamariBall permits swallowing/KO; any size ratio, contact direction, protection, collision handling, or simultaneous-contact resolution.
project_decision_or_prototype: Project retains swallow/KO and respawn as a project direction. The 1.35 size ratio in game design is a project prototype assumption only.

candidates.description: Use a parameter only after owner approval and deterministic authority tests.
candidates.reject_basis_if_not_selected: Leaves balance open and requires tuning evidence.

candidates.description: Select from multiplayer playtest data.
candidates.reject_basis_if_not_selected: No such data currently exists.

candidates.description: Gate the feature off in a test build if required evidence is absent.
candidates.reject_basis_if_not_selected: Would reduce the planned PVP feature set and alter test goals.

decisions.decision_owner: lead_for_project_rules; user_for_scope; T27/T39 testers for evidence
decisions.do_not_claim: 1.35 is neither original-game data nor a measured project balance value.

decisions.unit: time in seconds / score-resource effects unspecified
unknown: Whether KO and respawn exist; wait duration; spawn selection; protection; spectator behavior; carried item/power-up state; resource loss; catch-up supply.
project_decision_or_prototype: Project direction includes KO and respawn. Example values such as about 3 seconds wait and about 2 seconds protection are unvalidated project prototype numbers, not original rules.

candidates.option: Configurable short KO and safe respawn
candidates.description: Preserve participant status, clear input, respawn at a safe point, test low-tier supply.
candidates.reject_basis_if_not_selected: Timing, safety, and resource availability remain unvalidated.

candidates.description: Select only after multiplayer and comfort/fairness tests.
candidates.reject_basis_if_not_selected: Long or short values may create farming, snowball, or downtime.

candidates.option: No respawn in a particular test mode
candidates.description: Use only as an explicitly scoped experiment, not silently as final design.
candidates.reject_basis_if_not_selected: Conflicts with current project direction and changes match dynamics.

decisions.decision_owner: lead_for_project_contract; T27/T39 human testers; user for scope
decisions.do_not_claim: No original KO/respawn behavior or timing is established by available official sources.

decisions.unit: items; duration/effect values not established for PVP
official_confirmed: Official FAQ lists Magnet, timer, and rocket in the game and describes platform controls; announcement describes broad item effects.
unknown: Whether any of these items are available in KatamariBall; PVP spawn, inventory, duration, target, cooldown, interaction with KO/banking, and balance.
project_decision_or_prototype: Project chose a single slot with Magnet and Rocket; Jump rising edge is the project input direction. This is not a claim of original PVP item rules.

candidates.description: Implement only after project-specific transaction and platform input gates.
candidates.reject_basis_if_not_selected: Selected subset; may require balancing and platform testing.

candidates.description: Requires a separate user-approved scope change and rules design.
candidates.reject_basis_if_not_selected: Not in current v0.3 project selection; would expand implementation and testing.

candidates.description: Useful as a baseline comparison if a test needs isolating movement/fairness.
candidates.reject_basis_if_not_selected: Would not exercise selected power-up gameplay.

decisions.decision_owner: lead_for_project_rules; T04/T05 platform owners for input feasibility
decisions.do_not_claim: Original platform key mappings are not a VRChat mapping.

unknown: Whether one or two maps should be included in the first public release after playtests; this is a product choice, not an original-game rule.
project_decision_or_prototype: Current scope says first vertical slice one map/two players; launch target two maps (Picnic Lawn and Toyroom); Night Market is post-launch/optional.
T39 explicitly allows human approval to ship two maps or reduce to one complete experience.

candidates.description: Complete Picnic and Toyroom, then validate differentiated routes and fairness.
candidates.reject_basis_if_not_selected: More content, licensing, performance, and test workload; cannot sacrifice core quality to meet count.

candidates.description: Choose one fully validated map and defer the other; update task dependencies and acceptance first.
candidates.reject_basis_if_not_selected: Reduces launch variety; requires authorized scope decision and DAG change.

decisions.do_not_claim: This draft does not decide one vs two maps and does not change tasks.json.

decisions.unit: percent, meters, seconds, repeated trials; values unset
unknown: Acceptable spawn-resource variance; route and bank-time deviation; minimum respawn resources; restock delay; repeat count and statistical method; soft-lock criteria.
project_decision_or_prototype: Map rubric proposes normalized comparisons and evidence collection but intentionally does not set pass thresholds.

candidates.description: User/lead select candidate acceptance criteria, then collect evidence against them.
candidates.reject_basis_if_not_selected: Precommits before observational data and may be over/under strict.

candidates.description: Run explicitly exploratory rounds, publish results, then set acceptance values before formal validation.
candidates.reject_basis_if_not_selected: Exploratory sample cannot be retroactively labeled acceptance PASS.

candidates.description: Human reviewers assess route fairness and soft-locks without numerical thresholds.
candidates.reject_basis_if_not_selected: Less reproducible and may hide spawn/resource asymmetry.

decisions.do_not_claim: No fairness percentages, minimum resource counts, route margins, or replenishment limits are approved.

decisions.unit: collisionRadiusWorldM in m; semanticDiameter separate; gainVolumeUnits/bankedScore separate
unknown: Final maximum collision radius, growth bands, pickup thresholds, gain values, acceleration/physics limits and practical avatar/Station envelope.
project_decision_or_prototype: One shared world coordinate system; collision radius is distinct from semantic/UI size and visual mesh; confirmed ledger values drive score/PVP. 0.2–5 m is a user-selected presentation working range, not a technical maximum.

candidates.option: Parameterize until T06 and real map tests
candidates.description: Do not bake provisional values into public contracts.
candidates.reject_basis_if_not_selected: Delays precise map geometry and growth balance until relevant evidence arrives.

candidates.option: Approve a measured envelope after T04/T27/T39
candidates.description: Choose from build/device and real map playtests, then version the rule.
candidates.reject_basis_if_not_selected: Requires implementation/test availability and human approval.

decisions.do_not_claim: Presentation range is not a collision bound; visual mesh bounds do not establish gameplay size or gain.

unknown: Creator Economy eligibility, product catalog, legal/authorization review, platform pricing, tax/currency display, entitlement/transaction restore implementation.
project_decision_or_prototype: Design direction is free complete gameplay and only optional pure cosmetics; commerce remains gated and cannot affect play.

candidates.option: No paid SKU for first release
candidates.description: Keep store disabled or preview-only until all gates are approved.
candidates.reject_basis_if_not_selected: Defers monetization despite cosmetic-store direction.

candidates.description: Requires human selection of catalog/price and platform entitlement, license, and purchase recovery tests.
candidates.reject_basis_if_not_selected: Requires account authorization, approved entitlement API, and purchase/recovery evidence.

decisions.do_not_claim: No SKU, price, currency conversion, Creator Economy eligibility, or live purchase path is approved.

non_decisions: No root task status or dependency has been changed.
No one-map release choice, fairness threshold, original rule, numerical prototype, commercial SKU, price, or public interface has been approved by this document.
No Unity, game, VR, multiplayer, commerce, or original-game playtest was performed.
